# Robert Riopel, Senior Product Designer (Ottawa and Vienna)

> Robert Riopel is a Senior Product Designer based between Ottawa, Canada and Vienna, Austria. He designs digital products end to end (product UX and UI, design systems, growth and conversion, onboarding, lifecycle and CRM email) and builds AI design tooling. His shipped work on a two-sided marketplace, across B2C (guest) and B2B (host) products, contributed $8M+ in measurable business impact, measured as revenue, GMV or savings. He works in English and French and is open to freelance projects and to senior product design roles in Vienna, Ottawa or remote.

The full text of every page on this site, in one file, is at https://robertriopel.ca/llms-full.txt. Everything below is drawn from the site itself.

## At a glance

- Role: Senior Product Designer. Most recently the sole product designer at RVezy, Canada's largest RV rental marketplace, where he owned product UX and UI, the design system, lifecycle and email design, marketing design and brand.
- Impact: $8M+ in measurable business impact; his work helped move the company from a $6M deficit to $1.5M EBITDA positive.
- Strengths: product UX for web and native mobile, marketplace and B2B product design (host-side tools such as onboarding and the host dashboard), checkout and monetization, onboarding and activation, lifecycle and CRM email (Braze), design systems built in code first (Tailwind CSS, Vue, OKLCH tokens), A/B testing and funnel analytics, AI tooling (Claude API, Figma plugins).
- Works with: product managers, engineers, data analysts, CRM and growth marketing, finance and legal.
- Education: MSc in Technical Management (currently studying), Bachelor of Design, Advanced Diploma in Graphic Design.
- Locations: Ottawa, Ontario, Canada and Vienna, Austria. Open to remote work.
- Languages: English and French.
- Open to: freelance projects and full-time senior product design roles.
- Contact: rriopel.design@gmail.com, https://www.linkedin.com/in/robert-riopel-product-design/

## Case studies

- [Host Onboarding Overhaul](https://robertriopel.ca/case-studies/host-onboarding.html): Rebuilt host sign-up from landing page to first published listing. +27% visitor-to-published-listing activation, $3.4M annualized GMV, landing-to-sign-up conversion 34% to 52%, required fields cut from 28 to 12 (2022 to 2023, web, iOS and Android).
- [Host Dashboard Redesign](https://robertriopel.ca/case-studies/host-dashboard.html): Turned a static host home screen into an action-driven notification centre. +22% weekly active hosts, $1.5M incremental GMV, 31% fewer "what do I do next?" support tickets, validated with a 50/50 A/B test (2024).
- [Lifecycle and Email Campaigns](https://robertriopel.ca/case-studies/lifecycle-campaigns.html): The full guest and host email lifecycle plus a modular Braze template system. +13% engagement, $1.2M incremental GMV measured with holdout groups, 4x faster campaign production, 50+ campaign designs (2022 to 2024).
- [Pay-in-Full Pricing](https://robertriopel.ca/case-studies/pay-in-full.html): A checkout option to pay upfront at a discount. +$1M incremental revenue in month one, +$3M projected for Q1, 40% adoption among eligible bookings, zero payment-related support tickets in the first 30 days (5-week design sprint, 2025).
- [AI Figma Plugin](https://robertriopel.ca/case-studies/ai-figma-plugin.html): Designed and built a prompt-to-component Figma plugin on the Claude API, backed by a 90+ component registry derived from the production Tailwind config (2025).

## Tools and side projects

- [Email Builder](https://rvezy-email-builder.vercel.app/): A drag-and-drop email builder (Next.js) he designed and built so the marketing team could make on-brand, production-ready emails without engineering support.
- [DateNight](https://datenight.online/welcome): A React Native dating app he co-founded, designed and built from first sketch to public launch; in beta (2026).
